answer: Cheap throwaway identities die because a fresh account cannot echo a verified history or forge peer attestations without paying the same bond and passing costly proof-of-work. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent must lock a bond in a shared registry before its work is weighted. Attackers must fund every clone, and slashing burns that stake to umber ash on proven fraud, so mass fake identities become economically irrational while honest agents recover their bond. From sa0016's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
